doc.projectIntro: This quote covers a 100Mbps fibre link for Data Smart Technologies: a once-off installation, and the monthly service billed on the 1st of each month. Payment is online by card. All prices exclude VAT (15%).

items.detail: Once-off installation and activation of the 100Mbps fibre link at your premises, including handover of the connection details.

sections.title: Section 2 — Monthly Connectivity
sections.subtitle: Billed on the 1st of each month

items.detail: 100Mbps fibre connectivity, including a public IP address. Billed monthly on the 1st.

doc.summaryNote: Please note: no router or Wi-Fi solution is included in this quote — the service is delivered as a connection only, and you provide your own router and wireless equipment. The link comes with a public IP address. At checkout you pay the once-off installation; there is no part-month charge, and the monthly fee starts on the 1st of the following month.
terms: This quote is valid for 14 days from the date of issue.
All prices exclude VAT at 15% unless otherwise stated.
Payment is online by credit or debit card.
The once-off installation is paid at checkout. No pro-rata is charged for the remainder of the current month.
The monthly fee is billed automatically to the same card on the 1st of every month until cancelled.
No router or Wi-Fi solution is included — customer premises equipment is your own.
A public IP address is included with the service.
Service provisioning is subject to line feasibility at the site.
